properties.name: An assumed premise says how it is held; only a supposition left undischarged is not as stated
properties.rationale: Root cause, recorded on fact:a-chosen-principle-taken-up-as-assumed-raises-a-false-never-discharged-gap-2026-10-25 and fact:a-physical-models-stated-assumptions-read-as-reasoning-not-as-stated-2026-10-27: one property, `assumed`, carried three meanings (a proof's supposition, an argument's chosen principle, a model's idealization) and only the first had a reader, so correct work read "THE REASONING IS NOT AS STATED". Fixed with the findings' recommended option (a): the step says how it holds the assumption. statement_kind could not be reused as the discriminator (option b): Requirements like req:assume-* carry none, and skipping every non-hypothesis would change old designs. ADDITIVE: an assumption no step says anything about reads exactly as before (one gap, undischarged count unchanged, no new field), pinned by the test; the served tool gains one optional field and nothing is removed or renamed. Before/after: the new tests fail on main 983811cae (held_as unknown; the gap does not name it) and pass after; the readings golden moved only on detect_gaps for six fixtures, and putting the old gap wording back into the dumped readings reproduces main's golden digests exactly. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: add_inference takes `held_as` (supposition, principle or model), stored on each assumed premise's PREMISE_OF link (schema/inference.yaml, inference::HELD_AS). AssumptionReading carries `held_as` (a supposition anywhere wins, then principle, then model; absent when no link says). detect_reasoning_not_as_stated skips an assumption held on purpose (principle or model) and its text now names held_as; ReasoningDebt counts those in `assumptions_held_on_purpose` with ids (absent when zero), so loop_status's NOT AS STATED line no longer counts them; reasoning_report's assumption reads "held on purpose as a model/principle ... reads conditional on it". Refused: held_as with nothing assumed, and principle or model on a statement of kind `hypothesis` (which is a supposition by its kind: the existing statement_kind does not separate principle from model from an unmarked supposition, so it is reused only for that refusal). The design-an-argument skill (and its .claude/.grok copies) now says held_as principle. Test: an_assumption_says_how_it_is_held.rs.
